battle.name: 甲午戰爭
battle.theater: 朝鮮半島、黃海與遼東半島
battle.brief: 1894年朝鮮事變把清日之爭推上戰場，戰火自朝鮮半島蔓延到黃海與遼東。清廷倚北洋水師的鐵甲艦定遠、鎮遠，日本以巡洋艦配速射砲組成聯合艦隊。卡面這門線膛砲射程遠勝清軍滑膛老砲：平壤城下，日軍把攻城砲群擺到數公里外，用大仰角曲射把彈丸送進城牆之內；旅順之役，它一門門壓住俄造要塞砲。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 甲午戰爭自1894年7月下旬日本宣戰起，到1895年4月17日《馬關條約》換文為止，交戰主體是清朝與日本，戰場橫跨朝鮮半島北部、黃海海面與遼東半島。日本一方以明治政府為核心，陸軍由陸軍大臣山縣有馬與參謀本部統一調度，作戰計畫出自參謀總長與作戰課長井出薫之手；海軍編為聯合艦隊，以松島為旗艦，統轄裝甲巡洋艦、巡洋艦與魚雷艇隊。朝鮮方面，大院君金弘集一系與閔氏一族爭奪王位繼承，兩派爭鬥成了日清出兵的名目；清廷以保護朝鮮為名出兵，實際由袁世凱在漢城與平壤之間周旋撤兵事宜。英美兩國自居仲裁，卻只在外交上施壓；俄國向清廷提供軍事顧問與軍械，德國則向日本供應教官、克虜伯砲與造砲技術，中德之間的這條線，後來連到漢陽兵工廠的爐膛上。
countriesEn: The Sino-Japanese War ran from Japan's declaration of war in late July 1894 to the exchange of the Treaty of Shimonoseki on 17 April 1895. The belligerents were the Qing empire and Japan, and the fighting stretched across the northern Korean peninsula, the waters of the Yellow Sea and the Liaodong peninsula in Manchuria. On the Japanese side the Meiji government was the centre of all effort: the army was directed by the Army Minister Yamagata Aritomo and the General Staff, with the operational plan drawn up by the chief of the General Staff and by Inoue Kakū, chief of the operations section. The navy was organised as the Combined Fleet under the flagship Matsushima, covering armoured cruisers, cruisers and a torpedo-boat squadron. In Korea, the faction of Heungseon Daewongun Kim Hong-geop and the Min clan were fighting over the succession to the throne, and that feud became the pretext for intervention by both Tokyo and Peking. The Qing court sent troops under the banner of protecting Korea, and Yuan Shikai handled the withdrawal negotiations between Seoul and Pyongyang in the field. Britain and the United States claimed a mediating role but applied only diplomatic pressure; Russia supplied advisers and arms to the Chinese, while Germany supplied Japan with instructors, Krupp guns and the technology of gun-founding, a line that would later run straight into the furnaces of the Hanyang arsenal.
people: 清方的主導者是李鴻章，北洋軍務與對日交涉都握在他手裡；北洋水師提督丁汝昌在威海衛以服毒自殉收場，留下的絕命書成了這場戰爭最常被引用的片段；致遠艦管帶鄧世昌在黃海海戰中衝向日艦陣亡，平壤一役，淮軍將領聶士成在城北的白刃戰中陣亡，主帥葉志超則棄平壤而逃。袁世凱奉命撤兵卻遷延數旬，讓日軍先頭部隊得以推進，也讓他在天津收拾兵變時收編了定武軍，北洋陸軍的雛形由此而成。日本方面，首相伊藤博文兼領聯合艦隊統帥，山縣有馬主持陸軍全局，井出薫在作戰課上推敲每一次進攻的砲火配置，西鄉從道、乃木希典等人率師在遼東與旅順攻城。朝鮮義兵則在遼東游擊遲滯日軍，使日軍每推進一線都要多付出一份兵力。
peopleEn: The dominant figure on the Chinese side was Li Hongzhang, who held both the Beiyang military portfolio and the conduct of negotiations with Japan. Ding Ruchang, commander of the Beiyang Fleet, ended the war at Weihaiwei by taking poison, and the letter he left behind became the most frequently quoted document of the conflict. Deng Shichang, captain of the Zhiyuan, was killed charging the Japanese line at the Battle of the Yellow Sea. At Pyongyang the Huai Army general Nie Shicheng fell in close combat north of the city, while the commander in chief Yeh Chih-chao abandoned Pyongyang and fled. Yuan Shikai, ordered to withdraw the Chinese troops, procrastinated for weeks, which allowed the Japanese advance guard to move forward; the same man later disarmed the Dingwu Army during the Tianjin mutiny, and out of that transaction the embryo of the Beiyang Army was born. On the Japanese side Prime Minister Ito Hirobumi also took supreme command of the Combined Fleet, Yamagata Aritomo directed the army as a whole, Inoue Kakū worked out the artillery configuration of every offensive in the operations section, and men such as Saigo Tsugumichi and Nogi Maresuke led the divisions that fought in Liaodong and assaulted Port Arthur. Korean righteous armies harried the Japanese in Liaodong, and every line the Japanese pushed forward cost them an extra allotment of men.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是前膛裝填的線膛野砲，1850年前後的德國（普魯士）技術路線：炮膛內刻上螺旋膛線，讓同樣裝藥的彈丸在旋轉中貼緊膛壁，初速提高數百公尺，遠射時不再因彈丸跳飛而失準；此時速射的後膛砲還未普及，線膛前膛砲正是各國陸軍野戰砲的主流過渡型態。甲午一役，日軍野戰砲主力是仿普魯士十二磅砲改制的七十五公釐野砲與明治十八年制式七十公釐山砲，全屬前膛線膛，有效射程可達三千五百至四千米，射擊精度遠勝清軍仍大量裝備的滑膛老砲，射程不足一、兩公里。清軍自江南製造局與福州船政局機器局仿造線膛前膛砲數百門，湖北槍炮廠（後稱漢陽兵工廠）在1893至1894年間試造七十五公釐線膛砲，同時試製後膛速射砲。線膛砲的另一個身份是攻城砲：平壤城下，日軍把攻城砲群擺到數公里外，以大仰角曲射越過城牆；旅順之役，它面對的是俄造二百一十公釐要塞砲，只能靠彈藥密度壓過去。旅順陷落後繳獲的北洋軍械中火炮數百門、步槍數十萬枝，日軍就地補給，部分運回本國。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is a muzzle-loading rifled field gun, the product of the German, or Prussian, technical line of about 1850. The barrel is cut with spiral rifling, so that a projectile of the same powder charge, spinning against the lands, keeps close to the bore wall; the muzzle velocity rises by several hundred metres per second, and at long range the shot no longer wanders because the ball has jumped the rifling. The quick-firing breech loader had not yet spread at that moment, and the rifled muzzle loader was the standard transitional form of field artillery in every army. In the war of 1894 the Japanese field artillery was built chiefly around the seventy-five calibre field gun adapted from the Prussian twelve-pounder and the seventy calibre mountain gun of the Meiji year eighteen, both muzzle-loading rifled pieces, with an effective range of three thousand five hundred to four thousand metres and a far higher accuracy than the smooth-bore old guns that the Chinese armies still carried in large numbers, those having a range of only one or two kilometres. The Chinese obtained several hundred rifled muzzle-loading guns from the Kiangnan Arsenal and the machine works attached to the Foochow Navy Yard, while the Hubei Gun Foundry, later the Hanyang Arsenal, was producing a seventy-five calibre rifled gun between 1893 and 1894 and experimenting with a breech-loading rapid-fire gun at the same time. The rifled gun had a second identity as an arm of siege: before Pyongyang the Japanese planted a battery of siege guns several kilometres from the walls and lobbed shells over them at a high angle, and at Port Arthur the gun had to face Russian-built two hundred and ten calibre fortress artillery, which could only be beaten down by weight of ammunition. Of the Beiyang stores captured at Port Arthur, several hundred guns and several hundred thousand rifles passed directly into Japanese supply, and part of it was shipped home.
tactics: 日軍的戰術主幹是集中砲兵：以優勢砲兵群覆蓋一點，再以步兵在掩護下躍進，清軍往往還沒看清日軍的射界，彈雨已經落下。平壤之役，日軍白晝以攻城砲與野砲壓制城頭與牡丹台陣地，入夜後步兵摸近城牆爆破，黎明前一度攀上城頭；遼東方面，海軍取得制海權後，運輸船隊在旅順與大連之間接連登陸，部隊自背後切斷鳳凰城、蓋平的後路，再以攻城砲逐座壓制俄式要塞，最終奪下二百零二高地。清軍的部署則散而不整：入朝部隊、淮軍各鎮、練勇與綠營分屬不同系統，命令與火力無法統一；舊式壘牆的正面寬度是按滑膛砲時代算的，在線膛射程下等於活靶；後膛速射砲數量有限，無法在距離上爭取射速優勢；遼東的幾次反攻多以騎兵衝鋒衝向日軍步槍射界，損失極重。北洋艦隊在黃海因各艦自行瞄準、旗艦定遠中彈後失去統一訊號，齊射的優勢一散而盡。
tacticsEn: The backbone of Japanese doctrine was the concentration of artillery: a superior gun group was laid on a single point, and the infantry then advanced covered, so that before the Chinese could even make out the Japanese field of fire the shellfall was already on them. At Pyongyang the Japanese used siege and field guns by day against the ramparts and the Mudan Tai positions, and at night the infantry closed on the wall to place charges, reaching the crest before dawn. In Liaodong, once sea command had been won, transport convoys landed repeatedly between Port Arthur and Talien, the troops cut the rear of Fenghuangcheng and Kaiping, and siege guns were then worked against the Russian-style fortresses one by one until the height of 202 was taken. The Chinese deployment, by contrast, was dispersed and uncoordinated: the troops sent into Korea, the various banners of the Huai Army, the trained braves and the Green Standard all belonged to separate systems, and neither command nor fire could be unified. The frontal width of the old-style ramparts had been calculated for the age of smooth-bore guns, and against rifled range it amounted to a target standing still. Breech-loading rapid-fire guns were too few in number to win a contest of rate of fire at distance. Several Chinese counter-offensives in Liaodong were mounted by cavalry charging into the rifles' beaten zone of fire, and they were destroyed for it. In the Yellow Sea the Beiyang squadron lost the advantage of the salvo, each ship engaging on its own and the flagship Dingyuan, once hit, no longer transmitting the shared signal.
data: 可供核對的數字大致如下：戰爭自1894年7月23日宣戰至1895年4月17日換文，前後約九個月。日軍先後投入的兵力，通行估算為十七萬五千人上下，作戰陣亡約六千至九千人，負傷約一萬四千人，因病與水土不服而減員者另有數萬人；清軍在朝鮮與遼東投入的兵力，諸說從四十萬到六十萬不等，戰死與被俘合計多達二三十萬人。黃海海戰，日中各出動十二艘主力艦；北洋方面定遠、鎮遠以裝甲帶為基礎，裝甲帶厚約十四吋，主砲為十二吋口徑砲兩門，旁列十二公釐速射砲四門；日本旗艦松島為二千六百噸，主砲十五公分野戰砲兩門。交戰歷時五個半小時，日軍命中定遠的彈藥達兩百餘發，鎮遠亦受百餘發，北洋五艦自此失去戰鬥力，日軍亦有數艦重傷。旅順之役自10月24日打到11月21日，歷時約二十五天。平壤城下日軍架設的攻城砲群達十數門，另配大仰角曲射砲，把彈丸越過城牆送入城內。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war lasted about nine months, from the declaration of war on 23 July 1894 to the exchange of the treaty on 17 April 1895. The Japanese committed in the order of one hundred and seventy-five thousand men; killed in action are commonly put at six to nine thousand, wounded at about fourteen thousand, and sickness and climate produced further losses of several thousand. Chinese forces sent into Korea and Liaodong are estimated very differently, from four hundred thousand to six hundred thousand, and their killed and captured together are put at two or three hundred thousand. In the Battle of the Yellow Sea each side put twelve major vessels into the line. On the Chinese side Dingyuan and Zhenyuan were built on a belt of armour about fourteen inches thick, carrying two twelve-inch guns and four twelve-centimetre quick-firers; the Japanese flagship Matsushima was of twenty-six hundred tons with two fifteen-centimetre guns. The action lasted five and a half hours. The Japanese put more than two hundred shells into Dingyuan and more than a hundred into Zhenyuan, five Beiyang ships were thereafter out of the fight, and several Japanese vessels were also badly hit. The battle for Port Arthur ran from 24 October to 21 November, about twenty-five days. Before Pyongyang the Japanese emplaced a battery of siege guns numbering more than a dozen, with high-angle ricochet pieces that lifted shells over the wall and into the town.
cause: 直接導火線是朝鮮王位繼承的內鬥。1894年春，閔氏一系與大院君金弘集一系在漢城對立，朝鮮政府於6月2日正式請求清廷出兵鎮壓；清廷依約派兵，卻又命袁世凱率部駐紮漢城周邊，意在保全宗主體面。6月23日，日本陸軍以護送使臣為名攻入朝鮮王宮，逐出大院君，扶植閔氏集團，此舉使清廷不能再退。7月23日日本宣戰，7月25日豐島海戰開火，戰爭自此全面化。日本的深層算計在於：以朝鮮為踏板打開對華貿易與資源通道，用已經完成的近代化軍制檢驗國力，並趕在俄國勢力伸入滿洲之前取得位置；清廷則相信洋務以來的器械足以守土，宗藩體系不容日本插足，也低估了日軍集中砲兵與海陸協同的效率。國際層面上，俄國援清、德國援日，英美觀望，這讓兩邊都得到可以下注的訊號。
causeEn: The immediate occasion was a quarrel over the succession to the Korean throne. In the spring of 1894 the Min faction and the party of Heungseon Daewongun Kim Hong-geop were deadlocked in Seoul, and on 2 June the Korean government formally asked the Qing court to send troops to put the disorder down. Peking sent men as the convention required, yet also ordered Yuan Shikai to hold his force around Seoul, in order to save the face of the suzerainty. On 23 June the Japanese army entered the Korean palace under the pretext of escorting an envoy, expelled the Daewongun and installed the Min group, after which the Chinese court could no longer retreat. Japan declared war on 23 July, the clash at Pungdo opened fire on 25 July, and from that moment the war was general. Japan's deeper calculation was to use Korea as a stepping stone towards trade and resources in China, to test a modernised military system in the field, and to take up a position before Russian influence reached Manchuria. The Chinese court, for its part, trusted that the weapons built up since the Self-Strengthening Movement would hold the country, held that the vassal system admitted no Japanese interference, and underestimated the efficiency of concentrated artillery and of sea and land cooperation. At the international level Russia aided the Chinese and Germany aided the Japanese while Britain and America watched, and both sides took from that the signal on which they could stake their money.
impact: 馬關條約之後，晚清的處境被徹底改寫。台灣全島及澎湖列島易主日本，國人由此體認到瓜分之迫近，康有為在乙未年上書京師，孫中山於甲午之前已在檀香山組織興中會，救亡與變法自此成為清末最迫切的課題。軍事上，北洋水師全滅，淮軍體系崩解，清廷在天津平定兵變之際由袁世凱收編定武軍，北洋新軍就此成形；湖北槍炮廠在戰事正酣時開爐，漢陽兵工廠的線膛砲與後膛速射砲樣機成為清末軍工的重心，江南製造局與福州船政局同時擴產。財政上，白銀二億兩的賠款加上遼東借款等對外借貸，迫使清廷以稅源作抵押，財政與主權一齊流失。遼東半島先割予日本，兩年後因俄國與德法交涉而轉歸俄國；威海衛與旅順、大連其後分別成為英國與俄國的租借地，山東一度由日軍占領，沿海各省隨之被列強環伺。
impactEn: After the Treaty of Shimonoseki the late Qing position was rewritten from end to end. Taiwan and the Pescadores passed to Japan, and the Chinese came to feel how close partition was; Kang Youwei petitioned the capital in the year of the goat, while Sun Yat-sen had already formed the Xingzhonghui in Honolulu before the war broke out, and saving the nation and reforming it became the most urgent task of the closing years of the dynasty. Militarily the Beiyang Fleet was wiped out and the Huai Army system collapsed; while putting down the mutiny in Tianjin the court had Yuan Shikai absorb the Dingwu Army, and the new Beiyang Army took shape from that. The Hubei Gun Foundry was lit while the fighting was still on, and the rifled guns and breech-loading rapid-fire prototypes of the Hanyang Arsenal became the centre of late Qing military industry, with the Kiangnan Arsenal and the Foochow Navy Yard expanding production at the same time. Financially, reparations of two hundred million taels of silver, added to foreign loans such as the Liaodong loan, forced the court to pledge its sources of revenue, and both treasury and sovereignty drained away together. The Liaodong peninsula was ceded to Japan first and, two years later, after Russian and German-French negotiation, went to Russia instead; Weihaiwei and Port Arthur with Talien later became British and Russian leases, and Shandong was occupied by Japanese troops for a time, leaving the coastal provinces ringed by the powers.
result: 以成敗論，日本全勝而清廷完敗。平壤、遼東、旅順、威海衛次第失守，黃海與威海衛兩場海戰把北洋水師徹底打殘，定遠最終沉於威海衛，致遠、經遠、超勇、廣甲盡失，北洋一脈從此再無成軍之師。清廷在戰與和之間反覆，議和時已無籌碼，最後由李鴻章在馬關簽下條約，割地、賠款、開埠一併接受。戰爭的技術層面則被日軍完整繼承：線膛砲帶來的射程優勢、以海權換取登陸的戰役樣式、集中的砲兵運用，都被日本軍部寫進下一份作戰計畫裡。旅順與平壤繳獲的北洋軍械足以武裝數十萬人，日本以此為基礎，在隔年乙未之役中以更完整的常備軍再戰朝鮮與遼東。中日之間這場戰爭從此成為亞洲近代化差距的一張刻度，也把日本的下一個目標推到了俄國那一邊。
resultEn: By the measure of outcomes, Japan won completely and the Qing court lost completely. Pyongyang, Liaodong, Port Arthur and Weihaiwei fell in turn, and the two naval actions in the Yellow Sea and at Weihaiwei broke the Beiyang Fleet for good; Dingyuan finally went down at Weihaiwei, Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, Chaoyong and Kwangjia were all lost, and from that day the Beiyang lineage formed no more field army. The court oscillated between fighting and negotiation and had no cards left when it sat down to talk, and finally Li Hongzhang signed the treaty at Shimonoseki, accepting cession, indemnity and opened ports together. On the technical side the inheritance ran entirely to Japan: the reach that rifled guns gave, the pattern of a landing bought with sea command, the use of concentrated artillery, all of it was copied into the next operational plan of the Japanese army. The Beiyang stores taken at Port Arthur and Pyongyang were enough to arm several hundred thousand men, and on that basis Japan fought Korea and Liaodong again the following year with a far more complete standing army. This war between China and Japan became a measuring scale for the gap in modernisation across Asia, and it pushed the next Japanese objective onto the Russian side.
